title: Lemon
summary: Provides 2 Camp Supplies toward a Long Rest.

fields.Camp Supplies: 2 points. Standard full Long Rest requires 40 supplies, while Tactician and Honour typically require 80.
fields.Acquisition: Found in loot or sold by traders.
fields.Base value: 2 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
